observations.behavior: Adds a new parameter `wizard_limit_override` to the imports and its usage in the gateway token minting flow.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the wizard gateway token minting to accept an override for daily mint limits and USD caps, passing them to the reservation and minting functions.

observations.behavior: Passes the override's `mints_per_day` and `cap_usd` to the reservation and minting functions.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the daily mint reservation and the gateway token mint to use the override values instead of the configured defaults.

observations.behavior: Adds a test setup to mock the feature flag payload and clears the cache.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows tests to opt out of network calls for the feature flag, isolating the limit override behavior.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F4.H5 and P1.F5.H1, P1.F5.H2 are supplied; P1.F4.H5 is the only complete hunk with both removed and added lines. P1.F5.H1 and P1.F5.H2 are supplied but lack the removed lines, so the exact removed behavior is not observable. No tier assignment is possible.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional override parameter to reserve_wizard_mint and its rate-limit check, while P1.F4.H5 replaces the previous cap parsing and range-guarding with a dedicated _parse_cap helper and an override-aware cap selection.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows callers to override the wizard gateway token USD cap, while P1.F5.H1 and P1.F5.H2 show the rate-limit check now uses the supplied limit instead of the configured daily count when limit is provided. This could support tiered or program-specific mint caps and a more flexible daily limit, but the exact removed behavior and the caller that supplies the override are not visible.,
